note: XIX day scenes painted for light (Ian, 18 Nov: "paint light, shadows as brilliantly as possible").
style: A luminous plein-air oil painting of 1893 in the manner of the reference: academic realism, brilliant natural sunlight, strong raking light and crisp deep shadows, rich saturated colour, glowing skies, painterly brushwork. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Exterior at noon on a brilliant October day, 1893: the long brick front of the asylum blazing in sunshine under a deep blue sky with towering white clouds, sharp shadows of elms raking across the bright lawn, rooks wheeling over the chimneys. Any people are small, with no detail in their faces.

A doctor's study flooded with midday sun, 1893: brilliant shafts of light pouring through a tall window across a desk heaped with papers and a phonograph, dust glittering in the beams, deep warm shadows in the corners, the garden bright green beyond the glass. No people.

Exterior in strong afternoon sun: a barred ground-floor window of the asylum, the bars casting crisp striped shadows across warm stone and ivy, a pale face just visible inside, a fly glinting on the sunlit glass. Any people are small, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior on a golden October afternoon, 1893: low sun lighting the asylum front, one upstairs window where a young woman sits alone, small, the glass catching the light, autumn trees in gold and copper, long blue shadows on the grass. Any people are small, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior: the formal asylum garden on a brilliant autumn afternoon, sunlight through copper beeches, a marble statue glowing white against dark yews, dappled light on the gravel walk, leaves drifting. Any people are small, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior on a bright fresh October morning after rain, 1893: the asylum and grounds sparkling, sunlight breaking through moving clouds in great beams, wet lawn and gravel shining, the high wall and the dark roofs of Carfax beyond in contrast. Any people are small, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior: the Thames marshes near Purfleet on a clear sunny morning, 1893, a wide luminous sky, sailing barges with red-brown sails gleaming on the river, reeds glowing gold, the asylum small among trees. Any people are small, with no detail in their faces.
